tools.name: salesforce_search_objects
tools.description: Finds standard and custom Salesforce objects by partial name match.

tools.name: salesforce_describe_object
tools.description: Returns an object's schema: fields, relationships and picklist values.

tools.name: salesforce_query_records
tools.description: Queries records with parent/child relationships and complex WHERE filters.

tools.name: salesforce_aggregate_query
tools.description: Runs GROUP BY queries with aggregate functions, HAVING and date grouping.

tools.name: salesforce_dml_records
tools.description: Inserts, updates, deletes and upserts records, using external IDs for upserts.

tools.name: salesforce_search_all
tools.description: Performs SOSL searches across multiple objects, with field snippets.

tools.name: salesforce_manage_object
tools.description: Creates and modifies custom objects, their properties and sharing settings.

tools.name: salesforce_manage_field
tools.description: Adds or modifies custom fields and relationships on an object.

tools.name: salesforce_manage_field_permissions
tools.description: Grants, revokes, views and bulk-updates field-level access for profiles.

tools.name: salesforce_read_apex
tools.description: Reads Apex class source and metadata, including listing classes by name pattern.

tools.name: salesforce_write_apex
tools.description: Creates and updates Apex classes, with API version settings.

tools.name: salesforce_read_apex_trigger
tools.description: Reads Apex trigger source and metadata, including listing triggers by name pattern.

tools.name: salesforce_write_apex_trigger
tools.description: Creates and updates Apex triggers for objects, with API versions and event operations.

tools.name: salesforce_execute_anonymous
tools.description: Runs anonymous Apex and returns debug logs and results.

tools.name: salesforce_manage_debug_logs
tools.description: Enables, disables, retrieves and configures debug logs for users.
